comparison_policy.ambiguous_gate: two or more strong candidates within 0.03 composite-quality points
comparison_policy.exact_match_gate: unique candidate; exact fixed-normalized title; complete frozen OPDP statement; strong target-token coverage and contiguous token-run evidence
comparison_policy.no_strong_match_interpretation: abstention only, never evidence of corpus absence or newness; incomplete MathDB excerpts make non-match especially non-diagnostic
operations: Unicode NFKC and fixed typography folding
non-layout TeX command names exposed as lexical tokens
fixed title folding of one leading 'the' and terminal generic 'problem'
comparison_policy.required_evidence: title evidence plus statement/excerpt token evidence
comparison_policy.strong_match_gate: unique candidate; strong title evidence; and nontrivial statement/excerpt evidence. MathDB excerpts can qualify only as strong, never exact.

purpose: A conservative title-plus-statement identity crosswalk between a frozen ProofAtlas Top 500 release and frozen OPDP v1.7. It is not a corpus append, statement recovery, current-openness review, or OPDP rescore.

tool.name: OPDP ProofAtlas Top 500 conservative crosswalk builder
